fr_html: MM. ROOT, ADATCI, DE LAPRADELLE et LORD PHILLIMORE s'opposent à cette idée qui leur semble imprudente.
en_html: MM. ROOT, ADATCI, DE LAPRADELLE and LORD PHILLIMORE were opposed to this, as they thought it would be unwise.
